title: External non-exporting Demos transaction signing
description: Expose one provider-neutral Ed25519 callback seam for SDK-constructed Demos transactions while preserving the existing wallet path. Boundary: no provider-specific code, key custody, wallet management, general signing platform, payments, mainnet, or live transaction.

title: Add purpose-bound external Ed25519 transaction signer
description: Add an additive external Ed25519 signer contract that binds one public key/address, receives only the exact SDK-produced transaction hash bytes, verifies the returned signature, and reuses the current normalization/confirm/broadcast pipeline. Red-first substitution and concurrency tests; preserve connectWallet compatibility.
